Sound familiar?

Knowing what to eat is the easy part. Doing it on a Tuesday is the hard part.

  • It’s 5pm, everyone’s hungry, and nobody has a plan.
  • You save recipes all week and cook none of them.
  • You’ve heard the Mediterranean diet is great, but you’re not sure what it actually looks like on a plate.
  • Meal planning feels like a second job on top of your first one.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 45 minutes

The Mediterranean diet, explained simply

What it is, what it isn’t, and why it’s an eating pattern, not a list of rules.

The repeatable-meal method

How a small set of base meals you rotate takes the daily “what’s for dinner?” off your plate.

The pantry that makes weeknights easy

The handful of staples that turn into a dozen different meals.

Mediterranean style with a Southern twist

How to keep the food your family already loves and build around it.

Plan your week in one sitting

A simple weekly planning routine you can start this Sunday.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Do I need to be a good cook?

Not at all. Everything in the class is built around simple meals you can make on a weeknight.

What if I can’t make it live?

Sign up anyway. You’ll get the replay, so you can watch when it suits you.

Is this medical advice?

No. This is an educational class about Mediterranean-style eating. For personal medical guidance, please talk to your own healthcare provider.

Is it really free?

Yes. Come, learn the method, and decide afterwards if you want more help.

Script 1 · “Same dinners, on purpose”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I’m a dietitian, and I eat the same handful of dinners every week. On purpose.”

Body

“Because the hardest part of eating well isn’t knowing what to eat. It’s deciding, every single night. A rotation of a few Mediterranean meals takes that decision away, and the week gets so much easier.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how to build yours in a free 45-minute class. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera in the kitchen, cut to a week of plates laid out.

Script 2 · “It’s a pattern”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The Mediterranean diet isn’t a list of rules. It’s a pattern.”

Body

“Vegetables, beans, whole grains, olive oil, fish, and the food you already enjoy. Once you can see the pattern, you can build almost any meal around it, without a strict plan.”

CTA

“I’ll explain it simply in my free masterclass, The Easy Mediterranean Week. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “a pattern, not rules” with “pattern” highlighted.

Script 3 · “Southern twist”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You don’t have to give up Southern food to eat Mediterranean style.”

Body

“Beans, greens, tomatoes, a skillet of fish. Southern kitchens already have more Mediterranean in them than you think. The trick is building around what your family already loves.”

CTA

“Join my free 45-minute class and I’ll show you how. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, quick cuts of three familiar Southern dishes.
